questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: If force (F), velocity (V) and time (T) are taken as fundamental units, then the dimensions of mass are:
questions.explanation: Force F = [MLT⁻²]. Velocity V = [LT⁻¹]. Time T = [T]. Mass M = F/a = F/(V/T) = F V⁻¹ T.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: A body is projected with a velocity u at an angle θ with the horizontal. Its horizontal range is maximum when θ is:
questions.explanation: Range R = (u² sin 2θ) / g. R is maximum when sin 2θ = 1, i.e., 2θ = 90°, so θ = 45°.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: Two masses of 1 g and 4 g are moving with equal kinetic energies. The ratio of the magnitudes of their linear momenta is:
questions.explanation: KE = p² / 2m => p = √(2m KE). Ratio p₁/p₂ = √(m₁/m₂) = √(1/4) = 1:2.

questions.subject: Physics
questions.question: The escape velocity from the Earth's surface is v. The escape velocity from the surface of another planet having a radius four times that of Earth and same mass density is:
questions.explanation: Escape velocity v = √(2GM/R) = √(2G * (4/3)πR³ρ / R) ∝ R√(ρ). Since ρ is same, v ∝ R. Radius is 4 times, so escape velocity becomes 4v.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The number of atoms in 0.1 mol of a triatomic gas is (N_A = 6.02 × 10²³):
questions.explanation: Moles of molecules = 0.1. Moles of atoms = 0.1 × 3 = 0.3. Number of atoms = 0.3 × 6.02 × 10²³ = 1.806 × 10²³.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: Which of the following elements has the highest first ionization enthalpy?
questions.explanation: Ionization energy generally increases across a period. P has a stable half-filled 3p³ configuration, making its IE higher than Si and S.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: The hybridisation of Carbon in graphite is:
questions.explanation: In graphite, each carbon atom is sp² hybridized and forms hexagonal layers.

questions.subject: Chemistry
questions.question: For the reaction N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) ⇌ 2NH₃(g), the relation between Kp and Kc is:
questions.explanation: Δng = moles of gaseous products - moles of gaseous reactants = 2 - (1+3) = -2. Kp = Kc (RT)^Δng = Kc (RT)⁻².

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: If α and β are the roots of the equation x² - 5x + 6 = 0, then the value of α² + β² is:
questions.explanation: Sum α+β = 5, Product αβ = 6. α² + β² = (α+β)² - 2αβ = 5² - 2(6) = 25 - 12 = 13.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: How many words can be formed by using all the letters of the word 'BIHAR'?
questions.explanation: BIHAR has 5 distinct letters. Number of permutations = 5! = 120.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is correct about the cell wall of bacteria?
questions.explanation: Bacterial cell walls are primarily composed of peptidoglycan (murein). Cellulose is in plants, chitin in fungi.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: Which of the following is commonly known as 'pond silk'?
questions.explanation: Spirogyra is a filamentous green alga often found in fresh water and feels slippery to touch, hence called pond silk.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: The specialized cells called 'cnidocytes' containing nematocysts are a characteristic feature of:
questions.explanation: Cnidocytes are stinging cells used for anchorage, defense, and capturing prey, characteristic of Cnidarians.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.question: In roots, water and minerals are transported by the:
questions.explanation: Xylem tissue transports water and dissolved minerals from roots to stems and leaves.
